intro: Designed for convenience and charm, the Elixir table elevate every meal. Its marble top combines durability with timelessness, while the lazy susan adds functionality to your dining experience​.

features.title: Premium marble top
features.text: The table features a natural marble top, offering durability, elegance, and a sophisticated look that lasts for years.

features.title: Ash wood legs
features.text: A table that’s strong and stylish. Built with sturdy ash wood legs in a rich walnut tone, it brings stability and timeless charm to your dining space.

features.title: Lazy susan for serving ease
features.text: Make sharing meals easier—a detachable lazy susan keeps everything within reach for smoother dining experiences.

features.title: Compact size for smaller rooms
features.text: The sheesham veneer adds a polished surface that enhances your dining space with warmth and elegance.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Elixir 4-Seater Marble Circular Dining Table
